regimeSub: BOK delivers second consecutive hike to 3.00% as global CBs tilt hawkish ahead of Warsh Jackson Hole speech.
themes: BOK Governor Shin hikes 25bp to 3.00% in back-to-back move (Aug 27 Yonhap) → upgrades 2026 GDP forecast to 3.3%, flags inflation and nominal GDP as October rate guides; KRW firms to 1380
ECB's Schnabel signals rate hike per Bloomberg (Aug 27) → transatlantic hawkish coordination puts pressure on Warsh Jackson Hole speech; gold bid to $4658 on policy uncertainty
US stagflation stack intact: Q2 GDP confirmed at 1.5% (Aug 26 WSJ second estimate), July NFP -23k, CPI 3.3% → ING notes core PCE keeps Fed hike pressure elevated ahead of Friday print
Nvidia earnings imminent with $350bn implied move per Reuters → ASML trades at 40% AI capex premium (Aug 26 BigGo); SOX faces sternest test as SK Hynix/Samsung HBM thesis on trial

headline: Global central banks pivot hawkish as BOK delivers second consecutive hike and ECB's Schnabel signals tightening, while markets await Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole debut amid US stagflation backdrop of 3.3% CPI and 1.5% GDP.
